newsitem.title: FRANCE: ATHLETICS-PAPADIAS WINS WORLD INDOOR 60 METRES TITLE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PAPADIAS WINS WORLD INDOOR 60 METRES TITLE.

text.p: Greek Haralambos Papadias won the men's 60 metres title on the opening day of the world indoor championships on Friday.
Papadias clocked 6.50 seconds to snatch the gold medal ahead of Jamaican Michael Green, equal fastest man in the world this year.
Green clocked 6.51, with Nigerian Davidson Ezinwa third a further 0.01 of a second behind.
Canadian Bruny Surin, seeking his third consecutive title, finished fifth.
